emblems.prompt: Create a single new square cutout emblem for the original Grave Accord game, using the attached existing emblem as the style and material reference only. The icon is one compact 3D painted object viewed from slightly above, weathered charcoal iron with warm irregular brass rims and olive leather details. Match its directional light, matte texture, subdued palette and thick deliberate silhouette. Keep the complete emblem centered and within the middle 64% of the canvas for a 48 px skill card. Clear transparent alpha with generous empty margins. No text, numbers, hands, people, outlines outside the object, frame, vignette, glow, cast shadow or floor. Relief Watch shows a short straight double gate sill with three simple iron uprights and two completely open bays. One broad brass reservation token rides visibly on a horizontal sliding rail near the top. The token is pulled above the left-hand open bay, and the bare remaining length of the rail is visible over the right-hand bay. One olive pennant small enough to leave the two bays open. Readably different from the original split gate, which has one pennant in each bay and no sliding rail. Make the heavy sliding token the dominant feature, with no additional smaller hardware clutter.
